title: ml.get_buckets

anomaly_score.description: Returns buckets with anomaly scores greater or equal than this value.

desc.description: If `true`, the buckets are sorted in descending order.

end.description:
Returns buckets with timestamps earlier than this time. `-1` means it is
unset and results are not limited to specific timestamps.

exclude_interim.description: If `true`, the output excludes interim results.

expand.description: If true, the output includes anomaly records.

sort.description: Specifies the sort field for the requested buckets.

start.description:
Returns buckets with timestamps after this time. `-1` means it is unset
and results are not limited to specific timestamps.

from.description: Skips the specified number of buckets.

size.description: Specifies the maximum number of buckets to obtain.

job_id.description: Identifier for the anomaly detection job.

timestamp.description:
The timestamp of a single bucket result. If you do not specify this
parameter, the API returns information about all buckets.

description:
Get anomaly detection job results for buckets.

The API presents a chronological view of the records, grouped by bucket.
